question: Jat-Jatin is one of the most popular folk dance form of which among the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Bihar.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**Jat-Jatin

__
 
• **In the Indian state of Bihar, the Jat-Jatin is a popular folk dance.**
 
• It is particularly **well-known in North Bihar, particularly in the Mithila and Koshi regions.**
 
• Women's dance Jat Jatin is supposed to be performed on moonlit nights during the monsoon season.
 
• From midnight to morning, grown-up girls and young housewives assemble in the courtyard to dance to the beat of a drum.
 
• **It is usually done by two people.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**Folk the dance of Madhya Pradesh

 
• **The Muria dance, Madhya Pradesh is a famous folk dance** of Madhya Pradesh and is performed near the Ghotul compound.
 
• The dance starts with the boys carrying ritualistic offerings along with the bridegroom to the ceremonial place.
 
• In this dance, there are a variety of movements.

**Folk dance of Assam**

 
• **Bihu is the most popular folk dance in Assam.**
 
• Bihu dances are performed by young boys and girls during the Bihu festivities which represent youthful passion, reproductive urge, and joy.
 
• It is characterized by brisk dance steps and rapid hand movement.

**Folk dance of Chhattisgarh**

 
• The most famous dance drama of the State is **Pandwani,** which is a musical narration of the great Hindu epic Mahabharata.
 
• Raut Nacha ( folk dance of cowherds), the Panthi and Soowa are some of the other famous dance styles of the region.
